messages:
rowan: quick question about making invoice downloads more discoverable. people keep asking for a keyboard shortcut. is that better than moving the CTA?

sam: shortcut would be great for power users. but what key? `d` conflicts with browser bookmarks in some browsers. maybe `Shift+D` or `g then d` style chord?

keith: engineering caveat: single-letter shortcuts are risky. chords are safer but harder to discover. we could implement `Shift+Alt+D` as a default and allow users to remap in settings. must be behind FF.

rowan: discoverability is the problem. users who never see the shortcut won't benefit. CTA placement is more universal.

marta: analytics: 60% of invoice downloads happen within first 20s of page load. suggests CTA needs to be visible immediately (sticky summary or top-right). shortcut won't help that cohort. (query: analytics.downloads_quick)

sana: accessibility note: if we add a keyboard shortcut ensure it's announced in the keyboard shortcuts help dialog and is optional to enable in accessibility settings. Also avoid overriding assistive tech combos.

keith: agree. we can add the shortcut but keep it opt-in via a small toggle: "Enable quick download (keyboard: Shift+Alt+D)" in user prefs, default off. implementing remapping UI is a bigger project.

sam: thinking: do both. move CTA into a sticky summary (always visible) and add optional shortcut for power users. that covers both discoverability and efficiency.

rowan: that seems reasonable. mobile users can't use keyboard shortcuts so the sticky summary helps them. on mobile we could also show a quick-download FAB when the panel is long. but careful with overlap.

marta: experiment idea: AB test 1) Sticky summary with CTA, 2) Floating FAB, 3) Sticky summary + shortcut promo banner for new users. Measure download CTR and time-to-download. EXP-ID: EXP-INV-23.

analytics-bot: noted. I'll wire metrics: invoice_cta_visible, invoice_cta_click, invoice_shortcut_enabled, invoice_download_time.

sana: keyboard interaction details: when shortcut triggers download we should open the download modal (same as clicking CTA) rather than firing download immediately, so users can choose full ledger checkbox. Announce modal open with role="dialog" and focus trap.

keith: good point. also prevent accidental activation when typing in a focused input (check activeElement and ignore if it's an editable field). debounce to avoid rapid repeated presses.

sam: copy for the shortcut promo: small toast: "Tip: press Shift+Alt+D to open invoice download" with a "Don't show again" checkbox. Keep it dismissible.

rowan: UX nit: the sticky summary should include scope and date range. like "Viewing Org: Acme — Total $X — Download invoice" so users know exactly what they download. SR users will need that context too. add aria-labels accordingly.

sana: ensure sticky summary has role="region" aria-label="Billing summary" and the CTA has aria-describedby that points to a short text: "Downloads current view as CSV". the toast promo should be aria-live polite.

marta: for experiment, let's set the primary KPI to increase downloads within first 30s and reduce time-to-first-download. also track mobile vs desktop separately.

keith: plan: 1) implement sticky summary + responsive FAB on mobile (PR behind FF `sticky_summary_v2`), 2) implement optional keyboard shortcut toggle (FF `invoice_shortcut_v1`), 3) add promo toast for new users in experiment variant. ETA: PRs in 7 days.

sam: will update designs: sticky summary comps + FAB + promo toast. will include spacing tokens and safe area insets for mobile.

rowan: can someone own the accessibility doc for the shortcut and sticky summary? want a short checklist before release.

sana: I'll own it. checklist: 1) focus management for modal, 2) aria labels/descriptions, 3) shortcut is opt-in and documented, 4) no conflicts with common browser/AT combos, 5) keyboard-only flows tested in NVDA/VoiceOver.

marta: i'll coordinate analytics and experiment setup. sam, please add variants in figma and mark new components.

rowan: awesome. action items recap: keith->build FF branches + modal hookup; sam->figma comps + promo toast; sana->a11y checklist + testing; marta->experiment metrics + segments. aim to ship experiment next sprint. thanks :sparkles:
